description: Capability of the one webview a phone has (Android and iOS). No updater, because updates come through the store. No shell:allow-spawn, shell:allow-kill or shell:allow-stdin-write, because a phone starts no process. No window controls, because there is no window chrome. shell:allow-open stays for links that leave the app. lu-native:default is the native layer (share and save, device facts, lifecycle, the Remote transport, background downloads; mobile-docs/NATIVE-SCHICHT.md), deep-link:default the links that open the app (lu://oauth/callback, lu://remote).
